interface.name: treeland_screensaver_v1
interface.description:
This object implements a simple idle inhibit protocol used to implement org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver D-Bus interface.
Call inhibit to prevent treeland from entering idle state. Call uninhibit or disconnect from the global to release the inhibit.
If the client disconnects from the compositor, the inhibit associated with that client is automatically released.
There can be only one inhibit per client per time. Calling inhibit multiple times will raise an error. Call uninhibit before inhibit to update application_name and reason recorded.

request.name: inhibit
request.description: Inhibit idleness with given application_name and reason_for_inhibit.

request.name: uninhibit
request.description: Uninhibit idleness previously inhibited by inhibit request.

entry.name: not_yet_inhibited
entry.summary: Trying to uninhibit but no active inhibit existed

entry.name: already_inhibited
entry.summary: Trying to inhibit with an active inhibit existed
